schema_quotes.text: justified_by: [id, ...] names results that establish this item's well-definedness. Each target must depend on this item through deps; do not also put it in this item's deps.

Algorithmic properties (correctness, termination, complexity, invariants, etc.) are mathematical consequences in separate lemmas, theorems, propositions, corollaries or other ordinary result kinds, with complete proofs. Their deps include the algorithm they analyze. Use justified_by for well-definedness results that depend on the algorithm, following the existing definition rule; do not add the reverse deps edge.

justified_by_reconciliation.actual_operational_check: Neither algorithm lists its soundness theorem in deps or invokes it in any execution step. A successful output is defined by independently executable rational/interval inequalities. The corresponding theorem depends on that Definition and proves the semantic assertions from primitive suppliers. Thus the two opposite metadata references are the schema-required definition discharge, not an operational premise cycle. No theorem correctness is assumed to run either algorithm; no new termination or success claim is inferred.
